name: ec-corporate-income-tax
description: Ecuador corporate income tax (impuesto a la renta de sociedades) for tax year 2026 under the Ley de Régimen Tributario Interno (LRTI) and its Reglamento. Covers who is a sociedad and resident, the 25% general rate and the 3-point surcharge when ownership is not reported or runs through a tax haven with an Ecuadorian beneficial owner (applied pro rata below 50%), the reductions (3 points for micro and small companies and habitual exporters, 3 points for new investment, up to 5 points under investment contracts, 8% or 10% for reinvestment in qualifying programmes), the 2-point tax stability option, RIMPE for companies, losses (5 years, 25% a year), the voluntary advance, the 12% single tax on dividends (10% to non-residents, 14% cases) and the new payment on undistributed profits, the 10% single tax on share sales, withholding at source, filing in April by ninth digit, penalties and interest. Trigger on: impuesto a la renta sociedades 2026, tarifa 25% Ecuador, 28% paraíso fiscal, reinver
